reference: U. Ghia, K.N. Ghia, C.T. Shin, J. Comput. Phys. 48 (1982) 387-411, Table I (u at x = 0.5) and Table II (v at y = 0.5)

solver.discretisation: staggered MAC FVM, conservative van Leer flux, explicit projection, DCT-II Neumann Poisson

C1_u_profile_max_abs.statement: max |u_computed - u_Ghia| over all Table I points, in units of U

C2_v_profile_max_abs.statement: max |v_computed - v_Ghia| over all Table II points, in units of U

C3_u_min_relative.statement: relative error of the deepest reverse-flow u (Ghia -0.21090 at y = 0.4531)

C4_v_max_relative.statement: relative error of the strongest v (Ghia 0.17527 at x = 0.2344)

C6_divergence_free.statement: max |div u| of the converged discrete field (closed-box compatibility)

C7_steady_state.statement: steady-state residual max|du/dt|, |dv/dt| of the marching scheme
